_about: 角色名与专有名词。zh 是本作采用的定译；banned 列出的是这一版修掉的错译。banned 是纯子串匹配，所以只放真正该禁的写法 —— 一个同时也是普通中文词的字样放进去会误伤整库。

_kept_verbatim_why.count: 6 of 9,926 player-visible strings are byte-identical to their English source, and all six are Ren'Py phone-text substitutions -- the phone's message bubble interpolates [_text], [_text2], [_gt], [random_whisper], [_naomiText._text!i] and [lilithShort]-{w=1.5}{nw}. There is no English in them at all; the sentence arrives already assembled at runtime. tools/verify_patch.cjs re-derives this list from the patch and fails on anything untranslated that is not in it.

_variant_names._why: These are the near-collisions the revision pass had to settle. They are recorded rather than banned because the blunt substring rule cannot express them: 莉莉 is a prefix of the correct 莉莉丝, and 帕-帕克夫人 is Mrs. Parker stuttering on purpose.
_variant_names.Lili-: The Lilith stutter appears as both 莉莉丝- and Lili- in the shipped text. This patch keeps 莉莉丝- so the stutter stays a stutter instead of turning into English.
_variant_names.Siiiimon: Simon stutters as 西-蒙, matching how the other characters stutter in Chinese.
_variant_names.帕-帕克夫人: Mrs. Parker stuttering. The non-stuttering form is 帕克夫人 and it must stay the more common one.
